thingref.description: Required for a Subject Descriptor: exact local name of the selected TD Reference, whose class is https://xregistry.io/classes/thingdescription.

affordanceselector.description: Optional selection of one existing TD property, action or event affordance. Omission selects the whole Thing. Additional typed annotations are defined by the applicable profile.

pointer.description: Nonempty RFC 6901 JSON Pointer string selecting exactly one existing property, action or event affordance in the ordinary resolved TD. URI-fragment and percent decoding do not apply.
